text.en:
Using your Class Ability while within 15 meters of an enemy grants Super, Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy.

<hunter/>Hunters:
• (?)|(?) Super Energy with 1|2+ Mods equipped
• 3.5%|6% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy

<titan/>Titans:
• (?)|(?) Super Energy with 1|2+ Mods equipped
• 4%|7.2% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy

<warlock/>Warlocks:
• (?)|(?) Super Energy with 1|2+ Mods equipped
• 7%|12% Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy

Using your Class Ability while within 15 meters of an enemy grants Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy.

Ability Energy Gains with 1|2+ Mods equipped:
• <hunter/>Hunters: 3.5% | 6%
• <titan/>Titans: 4% | 7.2%
• <warlock/>Warlocks: 7% | 12%

Class Ability Usage while within 15 metres of an enemy grants Grenade, Melee, Class Ability, and Super Energy.

Energy Gains with 1|2+ Mods Equipped:
• Ability Energy: <pve 3.5% /> <pvp [1.75%] /> | <pve 6% /> <pvp [3.6%] />
• Super Energy: <pve 2% /> <pvp [1%] /> | <pve 3% /> <pvp [1.8%] />

Energy Multipliers based on Class:
<hunter/>Hunters: x1 | <titan/>Titans: x1.2 | <warlock/>Warlocks: x2

• Super Energy: <pve 2% /> <pvp [1%] /> | <pve 3% /> <pvp [1.8%] />

Energy Multipliers based on Class:
